verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a managed database service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes ways for external agents to work with the product: an MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others, CHKit commands an agent can drive, and isolated branches or read-only compute for agent runs. None of these is an assistant built into ObsessionDB that a user can hand tasks to, so they are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.
